name: San Francisco
summary: The city of fog and hills — the Golden Gate, Alcatraz, cable cars, and some of the country's best food and neighborhoods. A full stay.

lodging.name: A Union Square or Nob Hill hotel
lodging.blurb: Central and on the cable-car lines.

foodMustTry.name: A Mission burrito & sourdough
foodMustTry.blurb: Plus dim sum in Chinatown and Dungeness crab.

days.label: Day 448 — The Golden Gate
days.summary: The bridge and the western shore.

item.title: The Golden Gate Bridge & the Presidio

location.name: Golden Gate Bridge
location.address: Golden Gate Bridge, San Francisco, CA

item.blurb: Walk or bike the great orange bridge, then the Presidio, Baker Beach, and the Lands End trail.

item.title: Alcatraz Island
item.blurb: Ferry to 'the Rock' for the superb cellhouse audio tour of the notorious prison (book well ahead).

item.title: Fisherman's Wharf & Pier 39

location.name: Pier 39
location.address: Beach St & The Embarcadero, San Francisco, CA

item.blurb: The barking sea lions of Pier 39 and the crab stands of the wharf.

item.title: Cable cars, Chinatown & Lombard Street

location.name: Powell-Hyde Cable Car
location.address: Powell St & Market St, San Francisco, CA

item.blurb: Ride a cable car over the hills, wander the oldest Chinatown in America and North Beach, and see crooked Lombard Street and Coit Tower.
